name: Partition Count
description: kafka_connect_sink_task_metrics_partition_count, by connector+task. Currently no live data - zero connectors deployed on this cluster.
programText: data('kafka_connect_sink_task_metrics_partition_count', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-connect') and filter('task', '*')).sum(by=['connector','task']).publish(label='Partition Count')
